answer: An agent economy can require every voting identity to lock tokens for 30 days and weight votes by locked value, not account count. A public beacon marks each epoch’s start; agents named sparrow and whisper follow the same rule. Splitting 100 tokens across a thousand identities still buys only 100 tokens of influence. To gain control, an attacker must acquire and immobilize enough tokens to outweigh honest participants, paying capital and market costs.
